antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 670nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in melanocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Single-wavelength 810nm: CcO activation at 370 THz, 10^-15s, continuous wave 40min targeting cytochrome_c in melanocyte. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows electron transport +12% at 670nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial uncoupling_protein_UCP1 activation.
